To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) A complex LPC analysis method for estimating formant frequencies is proposed; 2) A noise reduction method using the signal (being analytic signal) is developed; 3) The FBLP method outperforms the covariance method for predictive coefficients estimation; 4) The proposed method outperforms some conventional methods in formant estimation in white noise.
The proposed method yields a better performance of formants estimation when compared to the conventional methods in white noisy speech.

1) the proposed method effectively utilizes both the real and the imaginary parts of the analytic signal to reduce noise; 2) the proposed method yields good performance when the signal to noise ratio (SNR) is high; 3) the proposed method is robust to the change of the noise level.
